title: Customer Care Advisor
description: The Customer Care Advisor is responsible for addressing and resolving customer queries with a focus on accuracy, completeness, and compliance. The primary purpose is to ensure the delivery of excellent customer service over the phone and in writing, by resolving issues and actively contributing to enhance customer satisfaction. This role involves managing and overseeing customer accounts, handling billing, metering data, account-related queries, as well as collaborating with other departments to improve processes and address customer concerns. The Customer Care Adviser plays a key role in maintaining high service standards, positive relationships with customers to promote loyalty and satisfaction. Experience: - Previous office experience - Previous experience working for service provider in customer facing role. - Previous finance / utilities experience Skills and Knowledge: - Excellent communication skills - Excellent telephone manner - Problem solving and decision-making skills. - Excellent organisational skills - Good general IT skills - (Microsoft Excel/Word/Outlook) - Excellent numeracy/literacy skills - Ability to multitask in high pressured environment - Excellent customer service ethos - Good attention to detail - Able to prioritise and manage own workload. - Good at problem solving, logical - Self-starter/pro-active They offer: - 25 days annual leave + 8 Bank Holidays - Generous sick pay and accident insurance - Loyalty bonus after 2 years of service - Life assurance (2x salary) - Private GP access and 24/7 confidential counselling (EAP) - Eye care reimbursement - Reward & Recognition programmes - Training Academy and mentorship opportunities - On-site perks: parking, gym, spa, and fun company events - Workplace culture: casual dress, bring your dog to work days To Apply You must be living in and authorised to work in the UK to apply for this position.

title: Customer Service Coordinator
description: Customer Service Coordinator Permanent Opportunity Based in Stevenage Monday to Friday 9:00am - 5:00pm 100% Office Based Permanent Salary: 28,000 - 30,000 per annum (depending on experience) Are you passionate about delivering exceptional customer service and building strong client relationships? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same? Our client is a prestigious and well-established packaging organisation with an excellent reputation for quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Due to continued growth, they are looking to recruit a Customer Service Coordinator to join their friendly and supportive team. The Role As a Customer Service Coordinator, you will play a vital role in supporting customers and distributors, ensuring every enquiry and order is managed efficiently from start to finish. You'll build long-term relationships with customers, identify opportunities to grow existing accounts, and deliver an outstanding customer experience at every stage. Key Responsibilities - Build strong, long-lasting relationships with distributors through proactive and professional communication. - Take ownership of customer enquiries and orders, managing them through to successful completion. - Process customer orders and quotations accurately within agreed timescales. - Recommend suitable products and prepare quotations tailored to customer requirements. - Follow up quotations and provide regular feedback to the Customer Service Manager. - Identify opportunities to upsell products and maximise customer value. - Work collaboratively with colleagues to deliver an exceptional customer experience. - Monitor sales trends and proactively identify opportunities for growth. - Become fully proficient in the company's internal systems. - Maintain accurate records and ensure excellent attention to detail at all times. - Support the wider team and undertake additional duties to contribute to the continued success of the business. About You We're looking for someone who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, and providing first-class customer service. You will be organised, motivated, and confident communicating with customers over the phone and via email. Ideally, you will have: - Previous experience within a customer service, customer support, sales support or account coordination role. - Excellent communication and relationship-building skills. - A proactive, positive, and results-focused approach. - Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise a busy workload. - Excellent attention to detail and accuracy. - Confidence working both independently and as part of a team. - The ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. - Good IT skills and the ability to quickly learn new systems. - A flexible approach and willingness to support the business when required. What's on Offer? - Permanent opportunity. - Permanent salary of 28,000 - 30,000, depending on experience. - Monday to Friday working hours (9:00am - 5:00pm). - 100% office-based role in Stevenage - Opportunity to join a prestigious and growing packaging organisation. - Friendly, supportive team environment with genuine long-term career prospects. If you're an enthusiastic Customer Service professional looking for your next challenge within a respected and growing business, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today! Please be aware this advert will remain open until the vacancy has been filled. Interviews will take place throughout this period, therefore we encourage you to apply early to avoid disappointment. Tate is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy. Tate is committed to promoting equal opportunities. To ensure that every candidate has the best experience with us, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments we can make during the application or interview process. Your comfort and accessibility are our priority, and we are here to support you every step of the way. Additionally, we value and respect your individuality, and we invite you to share your preferred pronouns in your application.

title: Service Administrator
description: Service Administrator Salary: £27,000 per year Location: Stevenage Hours: Monday - Friday, 9am to 5pm Contract: Permanent About the Role A fantastic opportunity has become available for a proactive and organised Service Administrator to join a growing operations team. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys variety, thrives in a busy environment, and takes pride in delivering exceptional service to clients and colleagues alike. As the first point of contact for support, you'll play a crucial part in ensuring service requests are handled efficiently, engineers are scheduled promptly, and clients receive a seamless experience. Key Responsibilities In this role, you will support the day to day running of the operations department, including: - Monitoring and responding to emails in the service inbox - Answering incoming calls to the Service Desk - Logging client requests across internal and external systems - Scheduling engineer visits and coordinating their attendance - Closing completed jobs on the internal job management system - Booking couriers and tracking shipments - Managing the return of faulty equipment to suppliers or manufacturers - Sending Welcome Packs to newly onboarded clients About You The ideal candidate will bring a positive attitude, strong organisational skills, and a commitment to excellent customer service. You will be: - Experienced in a similar service led or administrative role - Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail - Confident managing multiple tasks and prioritising effectively - An excellent communicator, both written and verbal - Friendly, approachable, and professional when dealing with clients - Reliable, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast paced office environment What's in It for You? - Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm working pattern - 23 days holiday plus bank holidays, rising with length of service - Supportive, friendly, and collaborative team culture - Pension scheme - Company Christmas bonus - On site parking - Regular company events - Full training provided with ongoing development opportunities

title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Customer Service Advisor Location: Watford Salary: 25000 per annum Hours: Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week Working hours: Flexible start between 8:00am-9:00am, finishing between 4:00pm-5:00pm with a 30-minute lunchbreak Contract: Permanent Start: Immediate About the Opportunity We are delighted to be recruiting for a Customer Service Advisor to join a well-established organisation that is currently going through an exciting period of growth. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a growing team at an important time for the business. As a Customer Service Advisor, you will become an integral part of the customer service team, providing a high-quality and professional service to clients throughout the full customer journey - from onboarding and quotations through to reporting, invoicing and managing day-to-day communications. You will play an important role in ensuring customers receive an excellent level of service, working closely with internal departments and external clients to ensure projects are delivered efficiently and effectively. This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established and expanding organisation where you can make a genuine contribution to the customer experience, develop your skills and build a long-term career within a supportive team environment. If you are organised, customer-focused and thrive in a busy environment, we would love to hear from you. The Role As a Customer Service Advisor, you will be responsible for delivering an excellent customer experience while working closely with internal teams and external clients. Key responsibilities will include: - Supporting the team with the administration associated with onboarding new clients and the continued delivery of excellent customer service. - Managing and responding to incoming client communications via email and telephone in a timely and professional manner. - Acting as a first point of contact for client queries and resolving issues wherever possible. - Escalating and coordinating queries with the appropriate internal teams where required. - Inputting and maintaining accurate customer information within LIMS and other internal systems. - Liaising with customers regarding sample paperwork, COCs and purchase orders. - Preparing accurate, fit-for-purpose quotations within the approved authority level. - Coordinating logistical queries and arrangements where required. - Managing subcontract laboratory services when necessary. - Liaising with analytical teams to ensure customer projects are delivered successfully. - Coordinating the delivery of customer receipts, reports and invoices. - Providing accurate client information and updates to the wider team. - Working with the SCSA and Customer Service Manager as part of a continual improvement process. - Building and maintaining strong, professional relationships with clients and internal stakeholders. - Processing media orders and developing knowledge of sampling techniques. - Completing result uploads, calculations and accurate data entry. - Checking data entry and calculations completed outside of the LIMS system. - Supporting the wider customer service function as required. These duties are not exhaustive and should not be interpreted as a complete definition of the role. About You We are looking for someone who is customer-focused, organised and confident communicating with a wide range of people. You will be comfortable working in a busy environment, managing competing priorities and maintaining a high level of accuracy. You will ideally have: - Previous experience in a customer service role - Experience working in a fast-paced environment - desirable. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. - A professional and confident telephone manner. - Strong customer service and interpersonal skills. - Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills. - The ability to manage your own workload effectively. - A collaborative, "one team" approach. - Excellent attention to detail. - Strong numerical and accurate data-entry skills. - Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office 365, Excel and Word. - The ability and willingness to learn and use various in-house systems and processes. - A positive and adaptable approach to change. - Flexibility and the ability to adapt to changing priorities. Company Benefits In addition to joining a well-established and growing organisation, the successful candidate will receive the following benefits: - Annual Leave: 22 days' holiday per year, plus bank holidays. - Healthcare: Healthcare provision. - Death in Service: Life cover equivalent to four times your annual salary. - Company Pension: Access to a company pension scheme. - Free on-site parking Interested?
